money: Amounts in the API are integers in piastres (1 EGP = 100).
defaultVariantRule: Prefer 1/4 kg (or 1/4 chicken) when it exists — the usual neighborhood order. Otherwise the only variant, otherwise the cheapest.
homeAndCatalog: Cards show ONLY the default variant name + priced default. Detail screen lists every variant. Cart lines are productId + variantId.
